summary_en: This study tests REGN5678 plus cemiplimab in men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. Both drugs are given by IV infusion. REGN5678 is given as three weekly doses in a lead-in phase, then the combination is given every three weeks; the total length of treatment is not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated; the study is listed as Phase 1.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa REGN5678 junto con cemiplimab en hombres con cáncer de próstata metastásico resistente a la castración. Ambos medicamentos se administran por infusión intravenosa. REGN5678 se administra en tres dosis semanales durante una fase inicial, y después la combinación se administra cada tres semanas; la duración total del tratamiento no se indica. La medida de resultado principal no se indica; el estudio figura como Fase 1.
who_for: Men 18 years or older with prostate adenocarcinoma confirmed by tissue or cells, not pure small cell.
Metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer that progressed after at least two systemic therapy lines, including one second-generation anti-androgen.
Adequate blood cell counts, kidney function and liver function as defined by the study.
Testosterone below 50 ng/dL with orchiectomy or ongoing LHRH agonist or antagonist therapy.
not_for: Currently in another interventional study, or used an investigational drug within 4 weeks of first dose.
Systemic therapy within 3 weeks, or radiation or major surgery within 14 days, before first dose.
History of autoimmune disease, with listed exceptions; or systemic steroids above 10 mg prednisone daily or immunosuppressants within 14 days.
Active infection needing systemic therapy, or recent heart events such as heart attack, stroke or blood clots within 6 months.
Other progressing cancer or prior cancer within 2 years, with exceptions; or interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis in the past 5 years.
